LanguageData.CC_PEv8_VoteGone: The election is over or no longer under way.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_FairRadio: The Republic's evening broadcast spoke of the colony tonight. {FACTION}'s clerk, {CLERK}, watched the vote at {COLONY} and the count this evening, and reports that every vote was read out and the count was fair.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_FairNoRadio: {CLERK} watched the count and says the colony's vote was fair. {CLERK} will report it to {FACTION}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Registered: {FACTION}'s clerk entered the result in the Republic's register, with the names of the council: {NAMES}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Observer_nocount: {CLERK}, the Republic's clerk, saw no count to watch and has gone back to the road without a report.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Observer_late: {CLERK}, the Republic's clerk, could wait no longer for the count and has gone back to the road.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_Roll: {0} walks round the {1} voters with the roll, then stands by the count this evening
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_Calmer: With the clerk there, a heckle at the count comes to blows half as often
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_FairRadio: The Republic's radio calls the vote fair this evening: +3 mood for 5 days for everyone at home who hears it
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_FairRadioBrief: a fair vote on the radio
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_Register: The result goes in the Republic's register: +3 mood for 15 days for the council's members
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Medal: {CLERK} of {FACTION} read the citation at the gate: {PAWN_nameDef} {DEED}. {CLERK} pinned the Republic's medal on {PAWN_objective}, and the Republic will remember {PAWN_objective} for it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_MedalPaper: {CLERK} of {FACTION} read the citation at the gate: {PAWN_nameDef} {DEED}. {CLERK} pinned the Republic's medal on {PAWN_objective} and left a copy of the Republic's newspaper with the citation printed in it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_MedalBack: Thank you, I only did what anyone would.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_MedalBack_3: The others were there too, it belongs to all of us.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_MedalLeft: {PAWN_nameDef} could not get out to the gate, so {CLERK} of {FACTION} went home without reading the citation or pinning on the medal.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_Citation: {0} goes out to {1} at the gate, who reads the citation and pins on the medal
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_MedalName: {1} remember {0} by name for it, and the colony's name grows with it
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_Heard: Everyone who hears the citation: +2 mood for 3 days
LanguageData.CC_Memory_Deed_medal_Name: {NAME}, and was given the Republic's medal for it
LanguageData.CC_Memory_Deed_medal_Many: was given the Republic's medal, {COUNT} times
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_DetailFights: {FACTION} is at war with the colony now, and the Guard detail at the gate has turned on the colony to take the deserter back.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_DetailFights: This turns the Republic against the colony, and the detail at the gate ({0}) fights
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_LedAway: The detail leads {0} away down the road
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_RationHungry: {X_nameDef} of {THING} has come in from the road to the ration post {PLACE} for a ration.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_RationHungryTwo: {X_nameDef} and another of {THING} have come in from the road to the ration post {PLACE} for a ration.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_RationShort: The ration post {PLACE} has run out of rations, and {THING} went away hungry.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_RationRiot: The rations at the post {PLACE} ran out with {THING} still waiting, and {THING} and {X_nameDef}, one of the guards, came to blows.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_RationTurned: {X_nameDef}, a guard at the ration post {PLACE}, turned {THING} away from the fire: {PEOPLE} are at war with the Republic.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_CardsDrawn: The clerk at the ration post checked the colony's papers and set {COUNT} rations down by the post's fire for the colony.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_NoPapers: The colony doesn't hold {0}'s citizenship papers.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_PostEmpty: The post has no rations left.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_Post: A clerk and two guards of {0} keep a ration post by the colony's road for a week, feeding the hungry who pass
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_PostTurns: If the rations run out, the queue may come to blows; the guards turn away anyone from a people at war with the Republic
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_GravShuttleDown: A shuttle of {0} has come down by the colony with two of the Fleet's officers.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_GravPodsDown: Drop pods of {0} have come down by the colony with two of the Fleet's officers.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_GravLogged: {FACTION}'s officers walked the {SHIP} with {PILOT} and entered it in the Fleet's log.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_GravLoggedPart: {FACTION}'s officers walked the {SHIP} with {PILOT}, entered it in the Fleet's log, and left {PART} from the hull's stores by its engine.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_GravLoggedLesson: {FACTION}'s officers walked the {SHIP} with {PILOT}, entered it in the Fleet's log, and taught {PILOT} what they know of flying it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_GravOutside: {FACTION}'s officers could not get aboard the {SHIP}, so they entered it in the Fleet's log from what they could see outside.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_GravOutsidePart: {FACTION}'s officers could not get aboard the {SHIP}, so they entered it in the Fleet's log from what they could see outside, and left {PART} from the hull's stores where they stood.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_ShipGone: The colony's gravship isn't here now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_Decks: Two officers come down near the {0} and walk its decks part by part, with {1} at the engine
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_SleeperStays: {PAWN_nameDef}, a sleeper of {FACTION} woken at the colony, has stayed and joined it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_SleeperHome: {RUNNER} opened the casket and woke {PAWN_nameDef}, who is walking home to {FACTION} with {RUNNER}. The Fleet paid {COUNT} silver.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_SleeperHomeOpened: {RUNNER} could not get to the casket, so {OPENER} opened it and woke {PAWN_nameDef}, who is walking home to {FACTION} with {RUNNER}. The Fleet paid {COUNT} silver.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_SleeperWalksHome: {PAWN_nameDef}, a sleeper of {FACTION}, woke from the casket and has set off to find the Fleet.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_CasketOpened: The casket has been opened, or is gone.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_OpenKeep: {0} opens the casket, and the sleeper wakes at the colony
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_OpenHand: {0} opens the casket and takes {1} home
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_OrderCouldNotGo: {PAWN_nameDef} couldn't set out for the hull.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_OrderThere: {PAWN_nameDef} has reached {FACTION}'s hull at {PLACE} and gives the order to disembark there.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_OrderHomeEarly: {PAWN_nameDef} came home from {PLACE} before giving the order.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_OrderHome: {PAWN_nameDef} is home from {FACTION}'s hull at {PLACE}, where {PAWN_pronoun} gave the order to disembark. The crew came down from their posts and stayed on at the hull.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_OrderHomeCrew: {PAWN_nameDef} is home from {FACTION}'s hull at {PLACE}, where {PAWN_pronoun} gave the order to disembark. {COUNT} of the crew came back with {PAWN_objective} and have joined the colony: {NAMES}. The rest stay on at the hull.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_OrderHomePeople: {PAWN_nameDef} is home from {FACTION}'s hull at {PLACE}, where {PAWN_pronoun} gave the order to disembark. The crew came down from their posts and have settled near the hull as a people of their own, {PEOPLE}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_OrderHomeCrewPeople: {PAWN_nameDef} is home from {FACTION}'s hull at {PLACE}, where {PAWN_pronoun} gave the order to disembark. {COUNT} of the crew came back with {PAWN_objective} and have joined the colony: {NAMES}. The rest have settled near the hull as a people of their own, {PEOPLE}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_RankedAway: {0} isn't at home to go now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_NoRank: {0} no longer holds a title of knight or higher.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_HullGone: The Fleet's hull is no longer within reach.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_Order: {0} goes to the hull at {1} as a caravan of one, about {2} days each way, and gives the order
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_OrderCrew: {0} of the crew come home with them and join the colony
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_OrderPeople: The rest of the crew found a people of their own near the hull, warm toward the colony
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_OrderPeopleWarm: The crew all found a people of their own near the hull, and think very well of the colony
LanguageData.CC_Arise_disembarked: {MEANS}: one of the colony's people of rank gave {PEOPLE}'s crew at {TOWN} the order to disembark, and the crew came down from their posts after two hundred years. Those who did not go to the colony have settled together as {NAME}.
LanguageData.CC_Arise_disembarked_scholars: They brought the ship's records and its library down with them, and keep them open to anyone who can read.
LanguageData.CC_Arise_disembarked_salvagers: They know the old machines better than anyone, and they live by taking apart what the world left behind.
LanguageData.CC_Arise_disembarked_traders: They carry what the ship's stores held along the roads, and trade it town to town.
LanguageData.CC_Arise_disembarked_Warm: They know it was one of the colony who gave the order, and they think well of it.
LanguageData.CC_Arise_disembarked_Plain: They have no quarrel with the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Arise_disembarked_Cool: They keep their distance from the colony.
LanguageData.CC_Arise_H_disembarked: The crew of {FROM} disembarked and settled together as {NAME}.
LanguageData.CC_Arise_Card_disembarked: Arose {AGO}: the crew of {PEOPLE}'s hull at {FROM}, who came down when the order to disembark was given.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_PartySick: {THING} of the landing party has fallen ill at their camp {PLACE}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_PartySickSleeper: {THING}, the sleeper the landing party brought, lately woken from the ship's caskets, has fallen ill at their camp {PLACE}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_WatchWarn: The watch of {FACTION}'s landing party has spotted raiders of {WHO} on the way to the colony, armed. They will be here soon, and there is a little time to get ready.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_PartyFed: They have their week's food already.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_NoMedic: None of them can see to the sick.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_Party: A landing party of {0} camps by the colony for five to seven days and surveys the land
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_PartyWatch: Their watch spots raiders first and warns the colony before they arrive, once while they stay
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_PartyTurns: A sleeper they brought may fall ill; a deckhand may ask to join against the officer's wish
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_GeneOut: {SEQ} took {GENE} out of {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_nameDef} will need a little more food from now on.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_GeneGone: That gene isn't there to take out any more.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_GeneOutWork: {0} works on {1} where they stand for two hours
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_GeneOut: {1} is taken out of {0}, with the game's mark of a xenogerm replicating afterwards
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_Hungrier: {0} gets a little hungrier, losing the metabolism that gene gave
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_XenogermIn: {SEQ} wrote a whole {KIND} xenogerm into {PAWN_nameDef}. {PAWN_nameDef} will lie in a coma for some days while it takes.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_WorkUndone: {SEQ} could not get to {PAWN} in time and has gone home without doing the work.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_WorkUndonePaid: {SEQ} could not get to {PAWN} in time and has gone home without doing the work, leaving the payment at the gate.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_XenogermWork: {0} works on {1} where they stand for three hours
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_Xenogerm: {0} becomes a {1}, the whole xenogerm written in
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_Coma: {0} lies in the game's xenogermination coma for some days afterwards
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_Faith: {0}'s faith, {1}, holds to its own kinds of people: {0} will mind being another kind
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_HybridBought: The {BEAST} from {FACTION}'s vats is the colony's now, with {PAWN} as its master.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_HybridGone: The {0} isn't at the gate any more.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_Hybrid: A young {0} joins the colony, {1} its master
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_LabLoose: The {THING} the Works brought to their field lab {PLACE} has got loose, and it is attacking anyone near it.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_LabSick: {THING} of the field lab {PLACE} has fallen ill with a fault in the genes the vats gave them.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_LabGeneQueued: A sequencer of the field lab will come to {A_nameDef} and write {THING} into {A_objective}.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_LabSampleQueued: A sequencer of the field lab will come to {A_nameDef} and draw a sample of {A_possessive} blood.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_LabBusy: They have enough of the colony's work waiting.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_NoGeneTaker: Nobody at home could take one of their genes now.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_NoRareBlood: Nobody at home has genes rare enough for them, or a sample is already waiting.
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_Lab: Two sequencers and a vat-keeper of {0} camp by the colony for a week, sampling the land, with their gene work open on the camp's page
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_LabTurns: A beast of theirs may get loose and attack; one of them may fall ill
LanguageData.CC_PEv8_Impact_LabGene: One of the Works' genes is written into {0}
